escalationRecipients.description:
CdoId: 3690; FieldId: 24969; Workspace: csi; Flags: None; Annotations: An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work.  The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security.

The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used.  Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.; OriginalType: Employee

displayName.description: CdoId: 3730; FieldId: 7291; Workspace: csi; Flags: ReadOnly; Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element.  For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object.   The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character.   This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used.  DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.
